sentences.text: Shri R. S. Rathore - Advocate for the appellants.

Shri Himanshu Tiwari- Panel Lawyer for respondent/ State
Appeal is already admitted for hearing.

Heard on I.A.Nos.5479/2023, an application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C filed on behalf of appellants No.3 Bhoggal Rathore, appellant No.4 Kashi Prasad Rathore, appellant No.5 Baldev Prasad Rathore and appellant No.6 Gaya Prasad Yadav Rathore.

Appellants along with co-appellants have been convicted for commission of offence under Section 420 read with Section 120-B, 467 read with Section 120B, 468 read with Section 120B and 471 red with Section 120B of IPC.

They have been sentenced to 5-5 years RI and 2 years RI and fine of Rs.2000-2000/- and Rs.1000/- each with default stipulation vide judgement dated 06.12.2022,
passed in S.T.No.192/2013 (State of M.P. Vs. Shehzad Ali and Others) by 1st, ASJ, Anuppur, District Anuppur.

entities.text: S.T.No.192/2013 (State of M.P. Vs. Shehzad Ali and Others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellants has submitted that appellants have been erroneously convicted as learned trial Court has not properly appreciated evidence on record.
Learned counsel for the appellants has pointed out the omissions and contradictions appeared in the evidence of the witness and have submitted that appellants have fair chance to succeed in appeal.
They are in jail for almost last 6 months.
Co-accused has already been released on bail.
Therefore, it has been prayed that appellants be released on bail.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.
Appellants have already suffered more than six months incarceration.
In course of trial they were on bail and they never misused the liberty granted to them by way of bail.
As per listing policy, there is no possibility of hearing of this appeal in near future.
Therefore having taken into consideration the submission of learned counsel for the parties and evidence on record, I am inclined to release the appellants on bail.

sentences.text: Consequently, I.A.No.5479/2023 i s allowed.

The execution of jail sentence of appellants - Bhoggal Rathore, Kashi Prasad Rathore, Baldev Prasad Rathore and Gaya Prasad Yadav Rathore is hereby suspended subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited.

It is directed that the appellants be released on bail on their furnishing a personal bond to a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) each with one solvent surety each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court with a further direction to appear before the trial Court on 22.8.2023 and also on such other dates, as may be fixed by that Court in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
List these cases for final hearing in due course along with connected appeals.
Certified copy as per rules.
